name: @marketnow/trust-core
description: UTA Verification Core v2.0.0 — ROADMAP LEAPFROG: the full trust stack in one zero-dependency package. v5.2 BEHAVIOR: behavioral baselines, statistical drift detection (7 signal classes, critical auto-revoke), network/filesystem/process behavior analysis. v5.3 POLICY: capability graph (filesystem/network/shell/credentials/process/payment/data manifests, MINIMAL_SAFE and FULL_ACCESS presets), org policies with ALLOW/REQUIRE_APPROVAL/BLOCK decision engine + approval workflow (STRICT/ENTERPRISE/PERMISSIVE presets). v5.4 TRAJECTORY: multi-tool attack chain detection (AC-001..AC-007 incl. read-.env-then-exfiltrate and search-read-download-execute), data-flow graphs with exfiltration paths, trajectory risk scoring with call-level blocking. v6.0 PREVIEW: cross-agent delegation with trust-score gates, memory poisoning detection. Plus: 12-stage verification pipeline, Ed25519 (RFC 8032), JCS (RFC 8785), PoP, revocation (CRL+OCSP+Bitstring), Merkle transparency log with signed tree heads (RFC 6962-style), TFP-1.0 tool fingerprinting with drift reports, evidence-first findings with confidence scoring. All smoke-tested 19/19. Zero runtime dependencies.
author: AliceLabs LLC <info@alicelabs.site>
